notes.title: Back to work Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42697118/62d42ccdfadd0dd3d1646a1b2399d5f42fad1a52.png[/img]
Hey witches!

We finally got our university degrees and are now getting back to work on Potion Tales.

In this update for our demo, we made the following changes:

• Improved performance.
• Replaced assets in the menus.
• Got rid of some cobwebs.
• Made improvements to lighting.
• Made minor improvements to dialogue lines.
• Fixed a bug relating to audio not being played or being played when it wasn't meant to play.

Happy brewing!

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The witching hour approaches[/h1]
[i]The smell of cinnamon and pumpkin fills the kitchen air, wolves are howling to the moon and the spiders work overtime, leaving cobwebs in every corner. Hallows' Eve draws near and with it comes a mysterious new potion, fickle as a will-o'-wisp and tasting of mischief.
[/i]
[h2]New content[/h2]
Try out a new recipe for the new [b]Potion of Hallow's Eve[/b], if you want to cause some spooky chaos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42697118/89b0c368a9257c9a2a40c701eff2e3d0fc0b76b8.png[/img]
The witches kitchen has got some new Halloween-themed decoration and a [b][strike]silent[/strike] quite talkative companion[/b] to judge your potion-brewing skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42697118/b1e008732a8d7d520435901cbd8ef011a12bbced.png[/img]
